sources.name: Federal Decree-Law No. 28 of 2005 (Personal Status Law)
Federal Decree-Law No. 41 of 2022 (Civil Personal Status)

steps.title: Submission to Family Guidance Committee
steps.description: Family dispute is submitted to the Family Guidance Committee for amicable settlement before initiating court proceedings, where applicable.

steps.title: Amicable Settlement Attempt
steps.description: Committee attempts reconciliation or settlement between the parties within the prescribed period.

steps.title: Referral to Court
steps.description: If settlement is not reached, the matter is referred to the competent court for adjudication.

steps.title: Filing of Family Case
steps.description: Family case relating to divorce, maintenance, custody, or other personal status matters is filed before the Court of First Instance.

steps.title: Hearings and Evidence
steps.description: Court conducts hearings, reviews evidence, and hears submissions from both parties.

steps.title: Judgment
steps.description: Court issues a judgment or order resolving the family dispute.

documents_required: Settlement report from Family Guidance Committee

escalation_paths.condition: Appeal against family judgment as permitted under UAE Personal Status laws
Appeal on points of law as permitted under UAE law
